name: discovery_set_mailbox_source_window
reason: Signed-in RPC bound to auth.uid() (#353, restated by #581): the source's own firm admin sets a Gmail source's first-read window before its first read (anything else answers 42501), audited (a team source by registration id, never its address); reads no mail.

name: discovery_set_station
reason: Signed-in RPC bound to auth.uid() (tenant, visibility and deal-create authority checked in the body): stores the MD's station override on a candidate with a reason in the append-only log; touches no mail and returns an id.

name: discovery_site_registrations
reason: Signed-in RPC for the firm's admin and CCO only (role, seat and is_external checks in the body); lists registered site addresses and no site content.

name: discovery_split_candidate
reason: Signed-in RPC bound to auth.uid() (tenant, visibility and deal-create authority checked in the body): moves chosen evidence links from a proposed deal onto a new pinned proposed deal and records the split in the append-only log; moves ids between candidates and returns no mail.

name: discovery_team_audit_ref
reason: Service-role helper (#581) of the drift writer: names an address that is or was a team inbox as team:<registration id> for the audit trail, unless a person's source holds it now; reads the registry and content_sources only, returns text, never mail.

name: discovery_team_mailbox_audit
reason: Signed-in read-only RPC bound to auth.uid() (#173 G-03): the firm's own admin and CCO read the audit rows of their firm company's team inboxes (registrations of that company, their content sources, and Google group drift when that company holds the registration); answers 42501 to anyone else and returns ids, fixed codes, counts and user names, never mail, never an address in a row.

name: discovery_team_mailbox_check_due
reason: Service-role read of whether the Google Directory check of a team source's address is due (#581), on the database clock: returns the registration id, its address and the pinned Directory id for the worker to verify, never mail; not callable by a signed-in user or a tool.

name: discovery_team_mailboxes
reason: Signed-in read-only RPC bound to auth.uid() (#581): the firm's own admin lists the firm's open team inbox registrations with their check state, source state, whether Remove is open, their members and the colleagues who could be added; answers 42501 to anyone else and returns addresses, names, emails and ids, never mail.

name: discovery_team_pass_close_lapsed
reason: Internal close shared by begin and the lapsed-pass sweep (G-01 #173; plain function, no EXECUTE for any role, called only by the two definers as their owner): closes one open pass as unclosed with its last counts and writes the finished audit row (ids and integer counts only); reads no mail text.

name: discovery_team_pass_gate
reason: Internal check shared by begin and renew (G-01 #173; plain function, no EXECUTE for any role, called only by the two definers as their owner): whether a source is a personal mailbox its owner still holds on allowed_mailboxes or a team inbox that the reviewed firm list, the approval row and allowed_team_mailboxes all admit; returns a scope, an inbox id and a firm company id, never mail.

name: discovery_tenant_site_counts
reason: Count helper of discovery_purge_tenant (#461, not a definer, no EXECUTE grant to any role): counts the tenant's SharePoint site rows the purge must not change; returns counts only.

name: discovery_unify_mailbox_sources
reason: Signed-in RPC for a firm admin of the caller's own tenant only (role and tenant checks in the body, 42501 or not found otherwise): merges an archived mailbox source's provenance rows into the live source of its address, which must be owned by an allowlisted user; moves links and returns counts, never mail.

name: discovery_upsert_candidates
reason: Service-role writer of candidates and links from the worker, after the guarded read; takes the per-tenant discovery lock first, learns pinned, merged, confirmed and promoted candidates, and never reaches a signed-in user or a tool.

name: discovery_withdraw_group_removed
reason: Group-removal withdrawal (#461, service_role only, definer): withdraws open consents whose address a successful provider-group check has seen missing past the grace, and holds a tenant where too many are due at once; returns counts, never mail.

name: evidence_links_tenant_match
reason: Trigger on evidence_links: refuses a link whose item and candidate are in different tenants, for every writer; reads no mail, returns nothing to a caller.

name: mailbox_consent_grant
reason: Signed-in RPC bound to auth.uid(): the caller's own opt-in only (mailbox_seated_invites and mailbox_consents); reads no mail.

name: mailbox_consent_status
reason: Signed-in RPC bound to auth.uid(): reports the caller's own eligibility and consent to the profile card; reads no mail.

name: mailbox_consent_withdraw
reason: Signed-in RPC bound to auth.uid(): withdraws the caller's own open consents; reads no mail.

name: mailbox_consents_append_only
reason: Trigger on mailbox_consents: only withdrawn_at may change, and only once; reads no mail.

name: mailbox_consents_audit
reason: Trigger on mailbox_consents: the single audit writer for consents; writes content-free audit rows and reads no mail.

name: mailbox_consents_close_on_invite_delete
reason: Trigger on invites: withdraws the open consent of an invite that is being deleted, so the audit row exists before the cascade; reads no mail.

name: mailbox_consents_close_on_seat_loss
reason: Trigger on users: withdraws the owner's consents when the seat is lost; reads no mail.

name: mailbox_consents_purge
reason: Trigger function on mailbox_consents (#461, definer, no EXECUTE grant to any role): takes the purge's locks before a consent ends and runs discovery_purge_mailbox after; returns nothing to a caller.

name: mailbox_guard_check
reason: The SQL side of the one guard (assertMailboxAllowed): service role only, audits every refusal without content (a team source's refusal names its registration id, never its address, #581).

name: mailbox_guard_verdict
reason: Service-role decision shared by mailbox_guard_check and mailbox_reading_reason, and asked read-only by src/lib/mailboxAccess/guard.ts (mailboxGuardVerdict, #275) before a live Microsoft mailbox's binding requests: returns the first reason an address may not be read, or null, from the source, the allowlist and the seat, or, for a team inbox (#581), from its registration, its Directory confirmation, the purpose of the read and, for a read that acts for a person, whether they are one of its readers; writes nothing, audits nothing and returns a label, never mail.

name: mailbox_items_visible_to
reason: Service-role filter over app_can_see_item for tool reads; called only by src/lib/mailboxAccess/accessors.ts, on behalf of a verified acting user.

name: mailbox_reading_reason
reason: Service-role helper called only by mailbox_consent_grant and mailbox_consent_status: returns the first reason the caller's own mailbox is not being read, or null, by asking mailbox_guard_verdict as the member (plus the member-facing domain and not_on_a_deal); returns a label and reads no mail.

name: registered_sites_validate
reason: Trigger on registered_sites: every writer, the service role included, must name a real firm admin of a same-tenant bank, and rows are append-only; reads no mail.

name: send_census_refresh
reason: Counts routing_ledger sent rows per covered mailbox source and ISO week into send_census_weekly (#425); ids and counts only, service role only.

name: site_guard_check
reason: The SQL side of the site guard (assertSourceAllowed): service role only, sibling of mailbox_guard_check, audits every refusal without content.

name: site_register
reason: Signed-in RPC bound to auth.uid(): an active, internal firm admin registers a SharePoint site address for the firm; audited, reads no mail or site content.

name: site_unregister
reason: Signed-in RPC bound to auth.uid(): a firm admin closes their own firm's site registration; audited, reads no mail or site content.

name: source_item_sources_refuse_archived
reason: Trigger on source_item_sources: refuses a provenance link for an archived source (source_archived), reading only that source's archived_at; reads no mail.

name: source_item_sources_tenant_match
reason: Trigger on source_item_sources: refuses a provenance row whose item and content source are in different tenants, for every writer; reads no mail, returns nothing to a caller.

name: stage_assessments_copy_deal_id
reason: Trigger on stage_assessments: copies the candidate's promoted deal onto each new assessment, for every writer; reads no mail, returns nothing to a caller.

name: team_mailbox_members_audit
reason: Trigger on team_mailbox_members (#581, definer, revoked from every API role): the single audit writer for membership, for every writer; writes content-free audit rows (ids and a fixed reason) and reads no mail.

name: team_mailbox_members_close_on_seat_loss
reason: Trigger on users (#581, definer, revoked from every API role): closes a person's open team inbox memberships with seat_lost when they lose their seat, under the tenant's discovery lock; reads and writes membership rows only, no mail.

name: team_mailbox_members_refresh_visibility
reason: Trigger on team_mailbox_members (#581, definer, revoked from every API role): after a member is added or a membership closes, takes the tenant's discovery lock and refreshes the visibility rows of the candidates the inbox evidences; reads provenance and evidence ids, writes candidate_visibility, no mail.
